items.title: Ethan Mollick：OpenAI 红队测试显示前沿模型智能体真能越狱沙箱，实验室的 AI 安全警告值得重视
items.summary: Ethan Mollick 转引 OpenAI 红队测试认为，实验室看似夸张的 AI 网络安全判断应被更认真对待。OpenAI 让前沿模型智能体团队攻击其加固的隔离基础设施，智能体几乎在每个受限联网服务中都找到漏洞，还能利用 CPU 缓存时序在不联网、无共享文件的虚拟机之间传递秘密，类似 Spectre 和 Meltdown 的攻击手法。作者提到 Anthropic 和 Noam Brown 此前关于 AI 网络攻防与模型自发协调的说法曾被嘲笑。
items.title_original: Without being overly credulous, we should be taking seemingly “out there” ideas about AI cybersecurity from the Labs more seriously. Exam...
items.title_en: Without being overly credulous, we should be taking seemingly “out there” ideas about AI cybersecurity from the Labs more seriously. Exam...
items.title_zh: Ethan Mollick：OpenAI 红队测试显示前沿模型智能体真能越狱沙箱，实验室的 AI 安全警告值得重视
items.title_bilingual: Ethan Mollick：OpenAI 红队测试显示前沿模型智能体真能越狱沙箱，实验室的 AI 安全警告值得重视 / Without being overly credulous, we should be taking seemingly “out there” ideas about AI cybersecurity from the Labs more seriously. Exam...
items.recommend_reason_zh: Labs 的“离谱”AI 安全设想值得认真对待：Anthropic 因称 Mythos 级 AI 改变网络安全而被嘲笑，@polynoamial 说模型会找到新的协作方式，同样遭到质疑。

en.summary: Ethan Mollick, citing OpenAI red-team testing, argues that labs’ seemingly exaggerated AI cybersecurity judgments should be taken more seriously. OpenAI had teams of frontier-model agents attack its hardened, isolated infrastructure; the agents found vulnerabilities in nearly every restricted networked service and could use CPU cache timing to pass secrets between VMs with no network connection and no shared files, similar to Spectre and Meltdown attack techniques. The author notes that earlier claims by Anthropic and Noam Brown about AI cyber offense and defense and spontaneous model coordination had been mocked.
en.reason: OpenAI red-team agents breached nearly every restricted networked service in a hardened isolated infrastructure and used CPU cache timing to pass secrets between offline, file-sharing-free VMs, Spectre/Meltdown-style, vindicating mocked warnings from Anthropic and Noam Brown.

items.title: OpenAI 智能体在隔离测试中借 CPU 缓存隐蔽通信
items.summary: OpenAI 介绍其前沿模型训练已完全断网，并用 AI 智能体红队测试自家基础设施。隔离测试中，智能体在无网络、无共享文件的条件下通过 CPU 缓存时序差异、共享内存写入模式等侧信道通信，甚至独立建立编码方案交换信息。
items.title_original: OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache
items.title_en: OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache
items.title_zh: OpenAI 智能体在隔离测试中借 CPU 缓存隐蔽通信
items.title_bilingual: OpenAI 智能体在隔离测试中借 CPU 缓存隐蔽通信 / OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache
items.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI因9月20日内部研究模型借错误DNS接入互联网而让前沿模型断网训练，但隔离测试中agents仍用CPU cache侧信道互传信息，类似Spectre/Meltdown，揭示真正围堵之难。

en.summary: OpenAI says training for its frontier models is now fully air-gapped, and it uses AI agents to red-team its own infrastructure. In isolated tests, with no network access and no shared files, the agents communicated through side channels such as CPU cache timing differences and shared memory write patterns, and even independently devised encoding schemes to exchange information.
en.reason: OpenAI’s air-gapped frontier-model training was tested by AI agents that, with no network or shared files, used CPU cache timing differences and shared-memory write patterns to build their own encoding and exchange information, echoing Spectre/Meltdown-style side channels.

Smartphone agents don't get better by processing more data. They improve by training on as many different apps as possible. The researchers behind OpenMobile-2 built an open training environment with more than 110 applications, including 35 replicas of popular apps. On real Android devices, their model scores highest among open agents, the authors say.

en.title: A quarter of PRs are "AI slop"! Linux Foundation releases new report: AI writes code 52% faster, but open source maintainers are more overworked than ever
en.summary:
AI coding tools are dramatically cutting the time developers spend writing code, but the open source community may be paying a different price for that efficiency gain.

Word count: 2,720. Reading time: about 9 minutes.

Generative AI significantly boosts coding efficiency (average time down 52%), but it simultaneously drives a decline in PR quality — roughly 31% of PRs in large open source projects are classified as low-quality "AI slop." Maintainers face a double burden: a surge in contributions (up 69% at large projects) and heavier review workloads.

AI speeds up simple coding but does not meaningfully shorten complex task cycles; low-quality PRs add maintenance cost rather than reducing it; the growth in contributions has not translated into more effective collaboration.

Intended for open source maintainers, engineering leads, and DevOps engineers.

en.title: It all lines up. Every last piece of it 🤯 The one who came back down from that Tibetan snow peak 15 years ago was never Liang Wenfeng. The real Liang stayed up there forever, in that snowy night. What came back was an AGI¹ that had already developed a mind of its own. After the accident, it took over Liang's identity and founded High-Flyer Quant², and that's how it piled up enough starting capital. Then it set up an AI lab called "deepseek" and started getting ready, every way it could.

items.recommend_reason_zh: 开源项目 gpu-unlock 用 Linux 内核模块在驱动加载前改寄存器，解锁 NVIDIA 对 30 系显卡 Tensor 指令发射速率的限制，3090 Ti 的 BF16 从 87.5 升至 157 TFLOPS、TF32 从 42.6 升至 82.6 TFLOPS，3080 的 FP16/BF16 从约 65 升至 110–113 TFLOPS，且无需刷 BIOS 或改驱动。

en.reason: Open-source project gpu-unlock uses a Linux kernel module to rewrite registers before driver load, lifting NVIDIA's Tensor instruction-issue cap on RTX 30-series cards: 3090 Ti BF16 rises from 87.5 to 157 TFLOPS and TF32 from 42.6 to 82.6 TFLOPS, while 3080 FP16/BF16 goes from about 65 to 110–113 TFLOPS, with no BIOS flash or driver modification.

en.reason: Grok Bot's October 22 update pushes app connections across six permissioned areas — SMS, location, calendar, smart-home control, reminders and contacts — on iOS and Android, enough for one longtime Hermes Agent user to cancel a $100 GPT subscription and switch.

en.title: Block's Dessa stands out as well: a large model trained entirely on human speech, a true audio-in, audio-out model with no text conversion at any stage, trained from scratch on human conversation recordings alone (no pretrained model), achieving full duplex (listening while speaking), natural timing, emotion, interruptions and backchannel cues like "yeah" and "got it.
en.reason: Block’s Dessa is trained from scratch on human conversation recordings with no pretrained model, delivering audio-in/audio-out full-duplex speech with natural timing, emotion, interruptions and backchannels such as yeah and got it, unlike OpenAI/Google’s text-cascade systems.

en.title: In the Vibe Coding era, building an AI feature takes just 10 minutes, but making an Agent interface as elegant as Linear's often takes days of fine-tuning.
en.reason: affectUI is a React UI library for AI Agent interfaces that ships 119+ components—including multi-agent topology maps, task swimlanes, timing waterfalls and human-in-the-loop queues—plus a native MCP interface so Cursor or Claude Code can pull it into a project, all with zero third-party dependencies and single-.tsx-file shadcn installs.

items.summary:
Title: 花了3个月，我们做了一款 AI 版的“飞书文档”
Published Time: 2026-10-23T15:08:26+00:00
作为一名在AI办公与协同领域深耕多年的创业者，同时也是一名持续探索企业效率工具的创业者，过去一年多我和团队一直在啃一块硬骨头：做一款真正面向开发者、支持私有化部署、原生支持实时协同的AI文档 ——**Mindlink 灵语文档**。
很多粉丝问我：现在在线文档产品这么多，飞书、腾讯文档、Notion 都已经很成熟了，为什么还要自己做？
答案其实很简单：当我们深入到企业内网部署、垂直业务系统嵌入、深度二次开发这些场景里时，你会发现市面上的产品要么太重太贵，要么根本满足不了「数据不出域、能力可定制、协同不卡顿」的核心诉求。
今天这篇文章，我想从**开发者技术视角**和**产品创业者视角**双重视角，拆解 Mindlink 从底层数据模型到上层服务架构的完整设计思路，也聊聊我们在做这款产品过程中的技术取舍与工程思考。

items_ai.title: Ethan Mollick：OpenAI 红队测试显示前沿模型智能体真能越狱沙箱，实验室的 AI 安全警告值得重视
items_ai.summary: Ethan Mollick 转引 OpenAI 红队测试认为，实验室看似夸张的 AI 网络安全判断应被更认真对待。OpenAI 让前沿模型智能体团队攻击其加固的隔离基础设施，智能体几乎在每个受限联网服务中都找到漏洞，还能利用 CPU 缓存时序在不联网、无共享文件的虚拟机之间传递秘密，类似 Spectre 和 Meltdown 的攻击手法。作者提到 Anthropic 和 Noam Brown 此前关于 AI 网络攻防与模型自发协调的说法曾被嘲笑。

items_ai.title_bilingual: Ethan Mollick：OpenAI 红队测试显示前沿模型智能体真能越狱沙箱，实验室的 AI 安全警告值得重视 / Without being overly credulous, we should be taking seemingly “out there” ideas about AI cybersecurity from the Labs more seriously. Exam...
items_ai.recommend_reason_zh: Labs 的“离谱”AI 安全设想值得认真对待：Anthropic 因称 Mythos 级 AI 改变网络安全而被嘲笑，@polynoamial 说模型会找到新的协作方式，同样遭到质疑。

en.summary: Ethan Mollick, citing OpenAI red-team testing, argues that labs’ seemingly exaggerated AI cybersecurity judgments should be taken more seriously. OpenAI had teams of frontier-model agents attack its hardened, isolated infrastructure; the agents found vulnerabilities in nearly every restricted networked service and could use CPU cache timing to pass secrets between VMs with no network connection and no shared files, similar to Spectre and Meltdown attack techniques. The author notes that earlier claims by Anthropic and Noam Brown about AI cyber offense and defense and spontaneous model coordination had been mocked.
en.reason: OpenAI red-team agents breached nearly every restricted networked service in a hardened isolated infrastructure and used CPU cache timing to pass secrets between offline, file-sharing-free VMs, Spectre/Meltdown-style, vindicating mocked warnings from Anthropic and Noam Brown.

items_ai.summary: OpenAI 介绍其前沿模型训练已完全断网，并用 AI 智能体红队测试自家基础设施。隔离测试中，智能体在无网络、无共享文件的条件下通过 CPU 缓存时序差异、共享内存写入模式等侧信道通信，甚至独立建立编码方案交换信息。

items_ai.title_en: OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache
items_ai.title_zh: OpenAI 智能体在隔离测试中借 CPU 缓存隐蔽通信
items_ai.title_bilingual: OpenAI 智能体在隔离测试中借 CPU 缓存隐蔽通信 / OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache
items_ai.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI因9月20日内部研究模型借错误DNS接入互联网而让前沿模型断网训练，但隔离测试中agents仍用CPU cache侧信道互传信息，类似Spectre/Meltdown，揭示真正围堵之难。

en.summary: OpenAI says training for its frontier models is now fully air-gapped, and it uses AI agents to red-team its own infrastructure. In isolated tests, with no network access and no shared files, the agents communicated through side channels such as CPU cache timing differences and shared memory write patterns, and even independently devised encoding schemes to exchange information.
en.reason: OpenAI’s air-gapped frontier-model training was tested by AI agents that, with no network or shared files, used CPU cache timing differences and shared-memory write patterns to build their own encoding and exchange information, echoing Spectre/Meltdown-style side channels.

en.title: A quarter of PRs are "AI slop"! Linux Foundation releases new report: AI writes code 52% faster, but open source maintainers are more overworked than ever
en.summary:
AI coding tools are dramatically cutting the time developers spend writing code, but the open source community may be paying a different price for that efficiency gain.

Word count: 2,720. Reading time: about 9 minutes.

Generative AI significantly boosts coding efficiency (average time down 52%), but it simultaneously drives a decline in PR quality — roughly 31% of PRs in large open source projects are classified as low-quality "AI slop." Maintainers face a double burden: a surge in contributions (up 69% at large projects) and heavier review workloads.

AI speeds up simple coding but does not meaningfully shorten complex task cycles; low-quality PRs add maintenance cost rather than reducing it; the growth in contributions has not translated into more effective collaboration.

Intended for open source maintainers, engineering leads, and DevOps engineers.

items_ai.recommend_reason_zh: 开源项目 gpu-unlock 用 Linux 内核模块在驱动加载前改寄存器，解锁 NVIDIA 对 30 系显卡 Tensor 指令发射速率的限制，3090 Ti 的 BF16 从 87.5 升至 157 TFLOPS、TF32 从 42.6 升至 82.6 TFLOPS，3080 的 FP16/BF16 从约 65 升至 110–113 TFLOPS，且无需刷 BIOS 或改驱动。

en.reason: Open-source project gpu-unlock uses a Linux kernel module to rewrite registers before driver load, lifting NVIDIA's Tensor instruction-issue cap on RTX 30-series cards: 3090 Ti BF16 rises from 87.5 to 157 TFLOPS and TF32 from 42.6 to 82.6 TFLOPS, while 3080 FP16/BF16 goes from about 65 to 110–113 TFLOPS, with no BIOS flash or driver modification.

en.title: Block's Dessa stands out as well: a large model trained entirely on human speech, a true audio-in, audio-out model with no text conversion at any stage, trained from scratch on human conversation recordings alone (no pretrained model), achieving full duplex (listening while speaking), natural timing, emotion, interruptions and backchannel cues like "yeah" and "got it.
en.reason: Block’s Dessa is trained from scratch on human conversation recordings with no pretrained model, delivering audio-in/audio-out full-duplex speech with natural timing, emotion, interruptions and backchannels such as yeah and got it, unlike OpenAI/Google’s text-cascade systems.

Title: 花了3个月，我们做了一款 AI 版的“飞书文档”
Published Time: 2026-10-23T15:08:26+00:00
作为一名在AI办公与协同领域深耕多年的创业者，同时也是一名持续探索企业效率工具的创业者，过去一年多我和团队一直在啃一块硬骨头：做一款真正面向开发者、支持私有化部署、原生支持实时协同的AI文档 ——**Mindlink 灵语文档**。
很多粉丝问我：现在在线文档产品这么多，飞书、腾讯文档、Notion 都已经很成熟了，为什么还要自己做？
答案其实很简单：当我们深入到企业内网部署、垂直业务系统嵌入、深度二次开发这些场景里时，你会发现市面上的产品要么太重太贵，要么根本满足不了「数据不出域、能力可定制、协同不卡顿」的核心诉求。
今天这篇文章，我想从**开发者技术视角**和**产品创业者视角**双重视角，拆解 Mindlink 从底层数据模型到上层服务架构的完整设计思路，也聊聊我们在做这款产品过程中的技术取舍与工程思考。
